messages:
emily: Nightly eval alert just flagged a large drop in QA pass rate for the 'customer-support' promptset on the new onboard-v3-int8 build — pass rate down ~14% vs baseline. link: https://ci.redwood/ev/3349991234 :warning:
raj: Ugh. Is this only on int8? what about fp16 / bf16 builds?
dana: fp16 is fine, bf16 looks okay. It's only the int8-quantized variant (onboard-v3-int8-packed).
ciara: I pulled a few failing examples — many are hallucinations or wrong entity grounding when the prompt contains multi-line JSON + code fences. short reproducer in thread.
emily: repro: ```prompt: "system:\n{\"user_metadata\": {\"region\": \"eu\"}}\n\nuser: summarize logs" model: onboard-v3-int8-packed```
mike: interesting pattern. my quick diff of outputs vs baseline shows token drift around the first backtick after the JSON block — subsequent decoding diverges.
oliver: could be tokenization + kv alignment with packed layout. but last week's packing patches were focused on dynamic-length attention and batching kernel changes, not tokenizer.
dana: I ran an attention-mask unit test — for dynamic-length optimization we added a fast-path that computed per-batch effective lengths; if a system message ends with a newline + backtick the length calc can miscount by one in edge cases. reproduces locally when sequence contains trailing control chars.
raj: that would shift KV indices and make the cached keys mismatch -> different attention context -> hallucination cascade. makes sense. nice catch.
emily: root cause hypothesis: dynamic-length attention fast-path off-by-one when trailing newline followed by code fence boundary -> misaligned KV offsets for packed-kv backend under per-seq batching, only triggers under quantized int8 path because quant kernel uses fused packed offsets that assume prior alignment.
ciara: timeline: packed-dyn-attn change landed two releases ago. int8 kernels were updated last week to use the new packed offsets (PR #4993). combination appears unique to onboard-v3-int8-packed rollout.
mike: mitigation options: 1) immediate rollback of PR #4993 for int8 kernels on serving; 2) disable dynamic-length fast-path for packed-kv in int8 builds (cheap toggle); 3) add a canary gating job that runs a focused promptset on every canary deploy and fails the rollout if pass rate delta > 3%.
emily: ops suggestion: rollback int8 kernels for hosted until we have a fix. we can keep fp16/bf16 online.
raj: agreed. also add a quick unit-test that constructs system+JSON+code-fence sequences and asserts KV offsets stable across batching.
dana: I'll open a patch to guard the fast-path off-by-one and add the test. planning to send PR today (assign to me).
oliver: deploy-bot: scheduling rollback for onboard-v3-int8-packed to onboard-v2-int8-packed on hosted-prod.
deploy-bot: Scheduled rollback job #RB-3349 queued, ETA 12m. will announce when completed. :robot_face:
emily: good. let's also add a canary gating rule: new model-int8 canary must pass the nightly 'structured-prompts' suite with >= 98% pass relative to baseline for 3 consecutive runs before auto-rollout.
ciara: I'll add the gating config and create a lightweight canary job that runs the focused promptset immediately post-deploy. thresholds: delta > 3% fail, hallucination rate absolute > 2% fail.
mike: add an alert to oncall if canary fails twice in a row.
raj: long-term: we should audit other fast-paths that changed layout assumptions and add a compatibility test matrix for quantized kernels vs packed offsets. add to eng-ml backlog.
emily: owners: dana for bugfix PR, ciara for gating config + canary job, raj for test matrix + follow-up. mike to coordinate alerting. target timeline: rollback now, patch & tests by EOD, canary live tomorrow morning, full roll-after 3 clean canary runs.
dana: PR #5009 opened: "guard dynamic-length fast-path off-by-one + unit tests". requesting review from raj and mike.
oliver: postmortem note: marking this as 'release-coupling' regression between runtime layout change and quant kernel update.
emily: thanks team. I'll update the incident channel & customer success with a short blurb: we noticed quality regression for some structured prompts on int8 builds; we rolled back int8 kernel change and are gating future canary rollouts until tests pass.
ciara: copied. I'll also pin a short promptset to the gating job (10 examples that reproduce the failure) so we get fast feedback.
mike: once rollback completes, I'll kick off a quick smoke eval against the nightly promptset and post results here.
deploy-bot: Rollback completed successfully to onboard-v2-int8-packed on hosted-prod. job #RB-3349 finished.
emily: confirmed — smoke eval (quick run) shows pass rate returned to baseline. closing this thread when PR merged and canary config live. :white_check_mark:
